entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Pavel Winternitz was a Czech-born Canadian mathematical physicist. He completed undergraduate studies at Prague University 
and received a doctorate from Leningrad University under the supervision of J. A. Smorodinsky. His research is on integrable systems and symmetries.
